title: CoRATES Request Performance
description: Rate, errors and duration for corates-workers-prod, built from the request.completed events that packages/web/src/server/requestCompletion.ts emits. Cloudflare does not export status or duration over OTLP, so this is the only place they exist in Loki. Production only; OTLP export latency is roughly 2-4 minutes.

list.name: route
list.label: Route
list.description: Regex over the normalized route, anchored by Loki. Leave as .* for everything, or narrow to something like /api/.* . UUID segments have already been replaced with :id.

list.name: slow
list.label: Slow threshold (ms)
list.description: Cutoff for the Slow requests log panel.

panels.title: Requests

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message="request.completed" | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}" .route ":id" }}` | route=~`$route` [$__auto]))

panels.description: request.completed lines in range. /api/client-logs is excluded at the emitter.

panels.description: Unmatched paths, almost entirely vulnerability scanners probing /wp-login.php, /.env, xmlrpc.php and similar. Excluded from every latency panel. A sustained rise is worth a WAF rule, not a code change.
